SCT_Apartment.text: ALEX AND MIRA'S APARTMENT — Modest, warm, contemporary domestic realism. Open window drapes, coffee, hallway footsteps, morning light. Ordinary grace is the point.

SCT_PatternSpace.text: PATTERN SPACE — Alex's inner chalkboard/circuit world: graphite grids, vectors, marginalia, coded notation, recursive marks and visual logic that can grow beautiful enough to become oppressive.

SCT_Transit.text: CITY STREETS / SUBWAY — Sidewalk stone, train platforms, tunnels, missed connections, phone glow, crosswalk timing and compressed public movement.

SCT_Park.text: PARK / QUIET CITY EDGE — A small pocket of stillness where confession can briefly outrun the city.

SCT_Marquee.text: EMPTY MARQUEE / NIGHT STREETS — Flickering bulbs, closed storefronts and familiar city corners that seem to remember a missing person.

SCT_RehearsalRoom.text: REHEARSAL ROOM — Functional room that can theatrically expand into Alex's imagined arena of posters, chants and fifty thousand voices, then collapse back to one person alone.

SCT_Workshop.text: COMMUNITY WORKSHOP — Flexible hall for music and movement. Taped floor marks can be removed. Chairs form an imperfect circle. Instruments and found percussion are available without hierarchy.

SCT_Rooftop.text: ROOFTOP — Open skyline, cold air and negative space. A place where Alex can stop filling silence.

SCT_Club.text: LATE-NIGHT CLUB / DANCE FLOOR — Rhythm, soft light and moving bodies. Flow replaces counting; avoid generic nightclub glamour.

SCT_Cafe.text: CORNER CAFÉ — Coffee steam, familiar smells, counter-store memory and small gestures. The reconnection must remain ordinary and unforced.

SCT_CityTableau.text: CITYWIDE TABLEAU — Screens, windows, sidewalks, transit and private rooms combined into one human-scale panorama for Empire Burn.
